alt: Muscles that move the humerus (OpenStax) - anterior view: pectoralis major, deltoid, coracobrachialis, subscapularis, teres major.
caption: Muscles that move the humerus (OpenStax) - anterior view. Pectoralis major + latissimus dorsi (adductors/medial rotators), deltoid (abducts), rotator cuff (SITS), teres major, coracobrachialis.
